description: Use this tool whenever a user asks about investing for a child or newborn, the OBBBA IRC Sec. 530A Trump Account ($1,000 federal pilot seed for 2025-2028 births + $5,000/yr cap, converting to Traditional IRA rules at age 18), comparing a Trump Account vs. 529 Plan vs. Custodial Roth IRA vs. UGMA/UTMA custodial brokerage, or modeling IRC Sec. 1(g) Kiddie Tax drag.

annualContribution.description: Total combined annual family contribution across all child accounts in USD.

birthYear.description: Optional 4-digit birth year (2025-2028 cohorts qualify for the $1,000 federal pilot seed).

childAge.description: Child current age in years (0 to 17).

childEarnedIncome.description: Child annual bona fide earned income in USD (required to fund Custodial Roth IRA).

custodialRothBalance.description: Starting Custodial Roth IRA balance in USD.

plan529Balance.description: Starting 529 College Savings Plan balance in USD.

trumpAccountBalance.description: Starting IRC Sec. 530A Trump Account balance in USD.

ugmaBalance.description: Starting UGMA/UTMA custodial brokerage balance in USD.

name: calculate_child_investment_and_trump_account
title: Calculate Child Investment Compounding Across IRC Sec. 530A Trump Account, 529, Custodial Roth & UGMA
